QuickPanel_HotkeyHint: The key that summons the panel is on the Hotkeys page. Once it is open, hold the "jump to Nth result" modifier and press 1-9 to switch workspaces.
QuickPanel_WorkspaceEnabledTooltip: Give this workspace a tab in the panel
QuickPanel_SourcesDesc: Each source is one group in the panel, shown in this order.
QuickPanel_PluginTabsDesc: Tabs the installed plugins offer, shown in the strip beside your workspaces. Untick one to take it out; the × on a tab does the same thing.
QuickPanel_SourceVisibleTooltip: Show this group in the panel
QuickPanel_SourceNameTooltip: Leave empty to use the default name
QuickPanel_AcceptsDropsTooltip: Files and folders dragged onto this group are copied into its folder, using Windows' own file copy. Always a copy, never a move.
QuickPanel_FilterPatternTooltip: One or more patterns separated by ';' or ',' (e.g. *.mp4;*.mkv). Leave blank for no filtering.
QuickPanel_ProcessesDesc: Apps this workspace belongs to, one process name per line (chrome or chrome.exe). Summon the panel over one of them and it opens on this workspace.
QuickPanel_BlacklistDesc: Apps the panel stays out of, one process name per line. Added to the global hotkey blacklist rather than replacing it.
QuickPanel_CloseWorkspaceTooltip: Close this workspace (turn it back on under Settings > Quick Panel)
QuickPanel_StayOpenTooltip: Keep this panel open when it loses focus
Favorites_Hint: Manage your frequently used shortcut folders and files for quick access in the quick navigation menu or search results.
Favorites_AddCardDesc: You can enter a custom name and target path -- URLs starting with http(s):// are also supported. Click the icons on the right to browse and select folders or files directly.
Settings_History_Hint: Manage and filter your search history and recently opened items in Lertaro, delete or clear them.
Settings_History_KeywordHint: Manage and filter the search keywords you've typed in the quick window, delete or clear them.
Settings_SaveTip: Changes will be saved to local configuration after applying.
Service_Hint: Manage the Lertaro search backend service.
Service_ErrorTitle: Unable to connect to background service
Service_ErrorStats: Background service is not running or not installed. Please click the button to install and start it.
Service_InstallingStats: This usually takes a few seconds, please wait.
Index_Hint: Manage the indexing scope for local and network drives, and view index status.
Local_Hint: Select the local drives to include in Lertaro, view index status, and rebuild manually.
Network_Hint: Select the mapped network drives to include in Lertaro. Network indexes are stored locally, independent of MFT.
Network_WslSectionHint: Select Windows Subsystem for Linux distributions to index in Lertaro.
Folder_SectionHint: Index individual folders instead of a whole drive. Folder indexes are stored locally, the same as network drives.
Folder_RootNotAllowed: A drive root can't be added as an index folder. Please choose a specific subfolder. To index a whole drive, use the "Local Drives" or "Network Drives" tab instead.
Exclusions_Hint: Exclusions apply both to local search results and network drive indexes. Network indexes will refresh after applying.
Exclusions_PathCardDesc: Enter full path or environment variable path, e.g. D:\Cache, Z:\temp, %ProgramData%. The directory and its subfolders will be excluded.
Exclusions_GlobCardDesc: Exclude glob wildcard patterns. Supports: * matches any characters in filename (excluding directory separator); ? matches a single character; ** matches subdirectories recursively. E.g. *.tmp to filter temporary files; **\node_modules\** recursively filters node module folders; bin\** excludes all files under bin.
Exclusions_RegexCardDesc: Exclude regular expression patterns for advanced filename/path filtering (performs implicit partial matching). E.g. ^\. excludes hidden items starting with dot; ~$ excludes Office temporary lock files; \.git\ excludes Git folders at any depth.
General_Hint: Control Lertaro startup behavior and log levels.
General_SysHint: Controls startup behavior, log level, and interface language.
General_AutoCheckUpdates: Auto check for updates on startup
General_AutoSilentUpdate: Auto silent update (when new version is detected)
General_EnableFuzzyMatchDesc: When off, a term must appear as a contiguous substring: "abc" no longer matches "a-b-c". Prefix a term with ' to keep matching it fuzzily.
General_GlobalTokenPrefixDesc: Global lead prefix character for splitting trailing query token expressions in the search box (default :).
General_DefaultFileManagerEnabled: Open folders with a third-party file manager
General_DefaultFileManagerHint: Redirects opening a folder (including "Open Folder Location") to the program below instead of the shell's own default.
General_DefaultFileManagerParameterHint:
Supports placeholder substitution:
· %s (or {}): the folder path
· Placeholders are quoted automatically -- don't wrap them in your own quotes
· Left empty, the quoted folder path itself is used as the sole parameter
General_LayoutHint: Customize the quick search window's appearance and how its search results are prioritized.
General_LayoutSectionHint: Customize the size, corner radius, and screen position of the floating search bar.
General_LayoutShowClock: Replace the placeholder text with date, time, and day of week when the search box is empty
General_LayoutReopenFullWindowOnHotkey: Pressing the hotkey again while this window is already open switches to the full window instead of closing it
General_LayoutLockPositionHint: Stops this window being dragged, so a stray press cannot nudge it off the spot you put it on. Right-clicking the status icon still resets its position.
General_ResultTypeOrderHint: Choose which result type wins when several equally-good matches tie in the quick window -- move a type up to make it always outrank the ones below it, regardless of which one actually matched the query text better. History and Favorites always come first and aren't affected by this list. Optionally, give a type a single-character trigger below -- typing it as the very first character shows only that type's results.
General_ResultTypeTriggerTooltip: Optional trigger character. Typing this as the first character of your search shows only this type's results. Leave empty for none.
General_PreviewWindowHint: Set the QuickLook preview window's size. This size is fixed and does not change with the number of results showing.
General_PreviewProvidersHint: Choose which provider gets first refusal when previewing a selected result -- move one up to make it always outrank the ones below it, regardless of each provider's own built-in priority. Disabled providers (see Settings > Plugins) aren't listed here since they'd never actually preview anything.
General_ThumbnailProvidersHint: Choose which provider gets first refusal when generating a result's icon/thumbnail -- move one up to make it always outrank the ones below it, regardless of each provider's own built-in priority. Disabled providers (see Settings > Plugins) aren't listed here since they'd never actually run.
General_SearchWindowHint: Set the full search window's default size. Manually resizing it by dragging an edge is remembered automatically.
General_SidebarGroupOrderHint: Reorder the filter groups (Type, Date Modified, and any plugin-added groups) shown in the full window's sidebar.
General_ColumnOrderHint: Reorder the columns (Name, Path, Date Modified, and any plugin-added columns) shown in the full window's results grid.
General_ActionMenuGroupOrderHint: Reorder the sections (built-in actions, Custom Actions, and any plugin-added sections) shown in the right-click actions menu.
General_QuickNavHint: Choose which order each provider's entries appear in at the top level of the Quick Navigation menu (the popup triggered by double/middle-clicking empty space). Disabled providers aren't listed here since they never show in that menu.
About_Hint: Lertaro is an ultra-lightweight, high-performance global search and productivity launcher for Windows.
About_Desc2: Locate applications, files, directories, and active Explorer window contents rapidly, with FZF-style fuzzy matching and pinyin aliasing for Chinese filenames.
About_Desc3: This is a stable release designed to enhance the Windows experience, offering three ways to search — a quick popup, a full main window, and an inline search bar — plus an extensible plugin SDK.
About_Desc4: Local disks are indexed via MFT and the USN Journal; network drives use user-mode scanning, caching, and listening; the SYSTEM-level background indexing service runs fully isolated from the per-user app UI.
